task.title: Make automatic memory generation provider-safe and background-routed
task.source: Direct user request to implement the highest-impact De-Koi speed optimization.
task.classification: provider transport, background generation, compatibility, and retry policy

coreClaim: Automatic memory work uses a dedicated background text connection when configured, NanoGPT GLM 5.2 receives only supported reasoning effort values, and explicit provider configuration failures do not consume repeated retries.
rootCause: Automatic memory jobs inherited the foreground chat connection, GLM 5.2 received unsupported reasoning effort values in the final NanoGPT body, and deterministic provider 4xx failures were retried like transient outages.

inScope: Automatic memory capture and maintenance routing
Terminal classification for explicit HTTP 400, 401, 403, and 404 failures
outOfScope: Foreground Fast, Balanced, or Quality controls
Changing memory extraction or cleanup prompts
Deleting or migrating stored memory data

riskClaimMatrix.coreClaim: Background memory work avoids known doomed provider calls without breaking existing text-connection fallbacks.
riskClaimMatrix.riskType: provider request and background orchestration compatibility
legacyPathsOrFormats: Queued capture jobs carrying only connectionId and model
positiveRowsTested: Agent-default text connection wins over the foreground fallback
GLM 5.2 maps high to high and xhigh or maximum to max
HTTP 400 and 401 fail automatic jobs after one attempt
negativeRowsTested: Image and disabled connections cannot become the background lane
Missing stored local-sidecar rows preserve the queued fallback
Non-GLM NanoGPT models retain none reasoning effort
HTTP 429, 5xx, and unknown failures remain retryable

groundTruthFacts.description: NanoGPT GLM 5.2 accepts only high or max reasoning effort in the observed provider contract.
groundTruthFacts.evidence: Live provider failures rejected none; focused Rust request-body tests prove the normalized final body.

groundTruthFacts.description: The local sidecar can be synthetic and absent from stored connections.
groundTruthFacts.evidence: The app catalog synthesizes the connection and the selector regression preserves a missing stored fallback.

positiveRows.evidence: The marinara-llm crate passed all 117 tests.

positiveRows.claim: Repository policy, architecture, frontend types, Rust workspace, and unused-code reporting pass.
positiveRows.evidence: pnpm check completed successfully on the final local base.

contradictionRows.claim: The fix must not strip reasoning effort from unrelated NanoGPT models.
contradictionRows.evidence: The non-GLM negative control retains none.

contradictionRows.claim: The fix must not turn transient provider failures into permanent failures.
contradictionRows.evidence: HTTP 429, 5xx, and unknown-error classifier rows remain retryable.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: Users without an agent-default connection retain their chat or default text connection.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: Selector and startup integration tests cover fallback and default ordering.

untestedRows: Post-merge production Pi telemetry is pending exact-image publication and deployment.

reviewThreadLedger.finding: Bunny found that a missing stored fallback could synthesize a connection with an id but no model.
reviewThreadLedger.fix: Synthetic fallback now requires a non-empty fallback model; otherwise selection continues to a real default or fails explicitly. A focused negative-path regression proves the resolver rejects a model-less synthetic fallback.

verification.baselineCommand: pnpm check; focused Vitest; cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/crates/llm/Cargo.toml; focused ESLint; git diff --check
verification.baselineEvidence: 71 focused TypeScript tests, 117 provider tests, repository-wide checks, focused lint, and whitespace validation passed.

notes: No user memory content, provider secrets, or API keys are included.
No UI behavior changes, so browser screenshots are not required.
Production Pi deployment waits for the exact merged revision's matched image batch.
